title: MatterGen: stable materials generated from desired properties
summary: A diffusion model generates stable, novel materials directly from desired properties: 2.9 times more stable, novel and unique structures than CDVAE, and over 250 materials with bulk modulus above 400 GPa versus 2 in the reference dataset. Results were checked with DFT calculations; experimental verification remains the ultimate test.

evidence.tested: Generated structures were checked with DFT calculations and compared with CDVAE and screening baselines (2.9 times more stable, novel and unique structures than CDVAE, per the blog); experimental verification is stated as not yet done.
evidence.unknown: Limitations stated: DFT has known limitations and experimental verification remains the ultimate test; the arXiv abstract states no limitations.
evidence.ai_role: A diffusion model generated new crystal structures conditioned on desired properties.
